# proxmox_cluster_mapping_usb (Resource)

Manages a cluster-wide USB hardware mapping through `/cluster/mapping/usb`, referenced by `usb.mapping`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_mapping_usb" "stick" {
  id = "usb-key"

  map = [{ node = "pve-1", id = "1d6b:0002" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stable mapping identifier (`pve-configid`). Changes require replacement.
- `map` (Attributes Set) Node to USB device mapping. Every entry needs `node` and either `path` or `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Mapping description.

### Read-Only

- `live_migration_capable` (Boolean) Always null; only PCI mappings support live migration.

<a id="nestedatt--map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `map`

Required:

- `node` (String) Cluster node the map entry belongs to.

Optional:

- `id` (String) Expected vendor:product id (`VVVV:PPPP`); optional when a port path is mapped.
- `path` (String) USB port path such as `1-2.3`.
